captions.detailed: An industrial cantilever articulated arm assembly rendered in dark gray and silver-metallic finishes. The structure begins with a vertical base column supported by triangular gussets on a rectangular floor plate, topped with a thick silver-gray collar housing. Extending horizontally from this collar is an offset shoulder bracket connected to two long, rigid rectangular arm links featuring recessed side pockets, rectangular access panels, and circular pivot joints. The arm terminates in a compact, circular tool flange, with the entire assembly designed to rotate horizontally at the base column and pivot vertically at the arm joints.
captions.instruction: Create a CadQuery script for an industrial cantilever articulated arm assembly. The model should feature a vertical base column with structural gussets, a rotating collar, an offset shoulder bracket, and two long, rectangular rigid links with recessed side details and circular pivot pins, ending in a compact tool flange.
captions.factory: The assembly is built using a modular ArticulatedObject framework. The base column is constructed from a cylinder combined with a rectangular plate and triangular gussets. The rotating shoulder collar and offset bracket are modeled using boolean unions of cylinders and rectangular boxes. The two main arm links are extruded with pockets and access covers, then assembled with cylindrical joint pins. Finally, the tool flange is created using a small cylinder and added to the end of the second link, with all components positioned using rigid transformation matrices.
